Firefox's built-in Eyedropper tool allows users to easily identify and copy the Hex (hexadecimal) values of colors found on web pages. This guide provides clear, step-by-step instructions for accessing and using this feature, making it simpler for creators to incorporate exact colors into their projects.
[[Image:Firefox Eyedropper 2]]

=Access the Eyedropper tool=
#At the top right, click the menu button [[Image:Menu hamburguer button|width=30]]
#From the dropdown menu, navigate to {menu More Tools} to find additional options.
#Click on {menu Eyedropper}. Your cursor will change to indicate the Eyedropper tool is active.

=Sample Colors from your screen=
After activating the Eyedropper tool, follow these steps to sample a color:
#Move your cursor to the area of the webpage with the color you wish to sample. The Eyedropper will display a magnified view for precise selection.
#Click on the color you desire. Upon clicking, the Eyedropper tool automatically copies the color's Hex value.
#The Hex value is now on your clipboard, ready to be pasted and used in your projects.
;[[Image:Firefox Eyedropper|width=240]]
